title: Published Connector
description: A vendor-published map from an MCP server's tools to Company OS capabilities, with the authority class each tool carries. Adopters bind roles to a connector instead of hand-writing tool allowlists. A connector never grants authority; it declares what each tool would do so the framework can bound it.

server_name.description: Name the adopter must use when registering the server in their runtime; tool names surface as mcp__<server_name>__<tool>.

system_kind.description: Suggested `kind` for the adopter's company-contract systems entry.

channels.description: Marketing channels this connector can fulfil, in marketing-profile platform vocabulary.

owner_roles.description: Role keys that may hold this tool. Empty means no agent role holds it; it is human-only or belongs to another department.

external_action.description: True if the tool changes something outside the company (publishes, sends, pays). The runtime guard requires an approval before any such call.

clearance_key.description: Tool-input field naming the artifact this tool acts on (e.g. postId). For an external action it is the artifact a reviewer must have cleared; for a mutating tool with invalidates_clearance it is the artifact whose clearance blocks the edit.

invalidates_clearance.description: True if the tool changes an artifact identified by a clearance_key; the guard denies it while a reviewer clearance for that artifact exists, so a cleared draft cannot be edited and then published under the clearance.
